name: techdrawai
description: Photo or text to technical drawing, CAD-ready DXF and DWG, printable STL, exact AI CAD parts (STEP), 3D models and product renders.
long_description: TechDraw AI turns a photograph of a physical part, or a written description of one, into engineering documentation, directly from Claude. Draft a dimensioned, standards-compliant 2D technical drawing (ISO or ANSI, first or third angle, working, assembly, as-fitted or patent), trace it into real CAD contours as DXF or DWG at true size, extrude artwork into a printable STL, model an exact, editable CAD part (STEP, STL, 3MF) from a description or a drawing and draw it as a dimensioned sheet, reconstruct a photographed object as a textured 3D mesh, or render it as a finished product shot. Tools: generate_technical_drawing, text_to_technical_drawing, image_to_dxf, image_to_stl, render_product, text_to_cad, drawing_to_3d, cad_to_drawing, photo_to_3d, check_job, identify_product and check_credits. Requires a TechDraw AI API key on the Studio plan; every generation is billed to your own account credits and refunded automatically on failure.

tools.name: generate_technical_drawing
tools.description: Turn a product photo into a dimensioned 2D technical drawing with orthographic views, dimension lines and the projection symbol (5 credits).

tools.name: text_to_technical_drawing
tools.description: Draw a part from a written description with its sizes, no photo. Stated numbers are drawn as given, anything left out is marked nominal (5 credits).

tools.name: image_to_dxf
tools.description: Trace any image into real CAD contours and write a DXF, optionally a DWG as well. Set width_mm for true size (free).

tools.name: image_to_stl
tools.description: Trace flat artwork such as a logo or stencil and extrude it into a watertight, printable STL (free).

tools.name: render_product
tools.description: Reconstruct the object described by a technical drawing and render it as a photorealistic product shot (5 credits).

tools.name: text_to_cad
tools.description: AI CAD: model an exact, editable part from a description (and up to three photos or sketches) as STEP, STL and 3MF. Starts a job for check_job (80 credits).

tools.name: drawing_to_3d
tools.description: Model the part a technical drawing or dimensioned sketch describes as exact CAD (STEP, STL, 3MF), its dimensions used as written. Starts a job (80 credits).

tools.name: cad_to_drawing
tools.description: Draw a finished AI CAD part as a dimensioned technical drawing made from the exact model (5 credits).

tools.name: photo_to_3d
tools.description: Reconstruct a textured 3D mesh (GLB, STL, OBJ, FBX, USDZ) from a photo of one object. Starts a job (80 credits).

tools.name: check_job
tools.description: Check a 3D or CAD job and save its files to disk when it is done (free).

tools.name: identify_product
tools.description: Name the main object in a photo, to fill in the product name before drafting (free).

tools.name: check_credits
tools.description: Show the account's credit balance, plan and per-operation costs.

api_key.title: TechDraw AI API Key
api_key.description: Your tda_sk_ API key from techdrawai.com/app (Settings, API keys). Requires an active Studio plan.
